name: TopMenu_Run
evidence: Top menu (3 icons: mail / homepage / help; screenshot at frame 1792 of 'help'): loads gfx from bank 1E, initial selection read from SRAM 1:$A8B9, loops until A (returns 1-3 = wRam_C0E5) or B (returns 0); called from 7C:7B85

name: TopMenu_Loop
evidence: Per-frame loop: 00:0956 sprites, 00:044B wait VBlank, Joypad_UpdateIdleFrames (7D:7BA4)/7BC1, then call JoypadDispatch with Table_TopMenu_Buttons (A, B, Select, Start, none)

name: Table_TopMenu_Buttons
evidence: JoypadDispatch inline table (5 words): A -> TopMenu_OnA, B -> TopMenu_OnB, Select/Start -> Label_1F_428E/428B (ignored), no button -> TopMenu_Idle

name: TopMenu_Idle
evidence: No A/B/Select/Start: Ticker_Update (48:4223), TopMenu_UpdateCursorMove, D-pad handling (TopMenu_HandleDpad), TopMenu_AnimatePanel; a pending A press (wRam_C0E3) is honoured once the cursor stopped

name: TopMenu_OnA
evidence: A pressed: if the cursor is still moving (wRam_C0E2) remember it in wRam_C0E3, else play sound id $2C (stub 00:20AC), fade out, write the selection back to SRAM bank 1 $A8B9 (48:4616: a=1, hl=$A8B9, b=item) and return A=selection

name: TopMenu_OnB
evidence: B pressed: play sound id $2E (stub 00:20AC), fade out, write 0 to SRAM bank 1 $A8B9 (WriteByteFar (48:4616)) and return A=0 (leave the top menu)

name: TopMenu_HandleDpad
evidence: D-pad: Right -> item 2, Left -> item 1, Down -> item 3, Up (from item 3) -> previous item wRam_C0E6; plays sound $2A/$2B (stub 00:20AC) and starts the cursor move

name: TopMenu_SelectItem
evidence: Sets wRam_C0E5=A, loads the cursor target (y,x) from Table_TopMenu_CursorTargets, TopMenu_StartCursorMove, sets wRam_C0E2 (moving) and calls Ticker_Stop (48:4460)

name: TopMenu_LoadPanel
evidence: Reloads the tilemap rectangle (bc=$1014 from bank 1E $40D7) and the item sprites (slots $DA40 etc.) for the selected item wRam_C0E5/C0E6

name: TopMenu_InitItemSprites
evidence: Creates the icon sprites of the selected item (objects from bank 1E table $656F, slots $DA10-$DA50) and places the cursor sprite at the item's target position

name: TopMenu_AnimatePanel
evidence: Every $1E frames swaps the animated icon tilemap of the selected item (bank 1E: mail 2 frames, internet 5 frames, size $C6 each) via 00:08EA and uploads it

name: TopMenu_UpdateCursorMove
evidence: Per-frame cursor interpolation: wRam_C0E1 steps left, adds the 8.8 deltas wRam_C0DD-C0E0 to the cursor position wRam_C0D4/C0D6 (sprite slot $DA50); on the last step snaps to the target and restarts the description ticker (48:42D4)

name: TopMenu_StartCursorMove
evidence: Computes |dx|,|dy| and direction flags (wRam_C10E) from the current cursor to the target wRam_C0DB/C0DC, step count wRam_C0E1 = (dx+dy)/8 and the 8.8 per-step deltas (Divide8 (48:4000) + Divide16)
